structure.unit: Registration and Modification of Child Support Order

law.catch_line: Recognition of order modified in another state
law.text:
If a child support order issued by a tribunal of the Commonwealth is modified by a tribunal of another state that assumed jurisdiction pursuant to the Uniform Interstate Family Support Act, a tribunal of the Commonwealth:
May enforce its order that was modified only as to arrears and interest accruing before the modification;
May provide appropriate relief for violations of its order that occurred before the effective date of the modification; and
Shall recognize the modifying order of the other state, upon registration, for the purpose of enforcement.
